type_zh: 量化研究 / 智能贝塔
desc_zh: Rob Arnott 于 2002 年创立的量化研究机构。开创基本面指数化 (RAFI) 与智能贝塔投资范式，按账面值、销售额、股息等基本面指标加权，挑战传统市值加权。不直接管理资金，而是把策略授权给 PIMCO、Charles Schwab、Invesco 等资管公司，截至近年约 1600 亿美元资产采用其策略。研究覆盖因子投资、估值、长期资产类别预期回报。
notable_en: Founder Rob Arnott created the Fundamental Index (RAFI) in 2005, sparking the smart-beta industry; the firm's 10-year asset-class expected return forecasts (Asset Allocation Interactive tool) are widely cited by institutional allocators.
notable_zh: 创始人 Rob Arnott 于 2005 年发布的基本面指数 (RAFI) 论文催生了整个智能贝塔行业；其十年期资产类别预期回报模型 (Asset Allocation Interactive) 被全球机构配置者广泛引用。
_confidence_notes: AUM figure '~$160B advised' references licensed-strategy assets-under-advisory (PIMCO/Schwab/Invesco etc.), not direct AUM — number may be 1-2 years stale (as of last public disclosure ~2023-2024). Founded year 2002 is well-established. HQ Newport Beach, CA confirmed via researchaffiliates.com contact page.
